segments.snp5.12:1.4: Santipadaṃ brūhi sahajanetta, yathātacchaṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.
segments.snp5.12:2.1: “Bhagavā hi kāme abhibhuyya iriyati, ādiccova pathaviṃ tejī tejasā;
segments.snp5.12:2.3: Parittapaññassa me bhūripañña, ācikkha dhammaṃ yamahaṃ vijaññaṃ;
segments.snp5.12:3.1: “Kāmesu vinaya gedhaṃ,(jatukaṇṇīti bhagavā) nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato;
segments.snp5.12:3.4: Uggahītaṃ nirattaṃ vā, mā te vijjittha kiñcanaṃ.
segments.snp5.12:4.1: “Yaṃ pubbe taṃ visosehi, pacchā te māhu kiñcanaṃ;
segments.snp5.12:4.3: Majjhe ce no gahessasi, upasanto carissasi.
segments.snp5.12:5.3: Āsavāssa na vijjanti, yehi maccuvasaṃ vaje”ti.

lines: Tattha sutvānahaṃ vīramakāmakāminti ahaṃ “itipi so bhagavā”tiādinā nayena vīraṃ kāmānaṃ akāmanato akāmakāmiṃ buddhaṃ sutvā.
Yācanto hi sahassakkhattumpi bhaṇeyya, ko pana vādo dvikkhattuṃ.
Yamahaṃ vijaññaṃ jātijarāya idha vippahānanti yamahaṃ jātijarānaṃ pahānabhūtaṃ dhammaṃ idheva jāneyyaṃ.
1105-7. Athassa bhagavā taṃ dhammamācikkhanto tisso gāthāyo abhāsi.
Tattha nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khematoti nibbānañca nibbānagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ “kheman”ti disvā.
Nirattaṃ vāti nirassitabbaṃ vā, muñcitabbanti vuttaṃ hoti.
